title: Contour Next One (any Bluetooth) - When reading is done, there is a lot of error messages, trying to duplicate already added data (from history) to NS
symptom: When making a measurement with the Contour Next One, the whole history is read and xDrip tries to add each entry again into Nightscout (UploaderQueue). All entries except the last fail because they are already in NS.
evidence_quote: When I make measurment with my Contour Next One whole history is read, and then xDrip tries to add each entry again into Nightscout (UploaderQueue). All entries, except last fail, because they are already in NS.
